subject: Request: Temporary supplier admission — invoice-only / no-PO for pilot
messages:
From: procurement@cloudfoundrylabs.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary supplier onboarding + invoice-only (no PO) for pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — we are excited to run a small pilot with Redwood. Quick context: CloudFoundry Labs is a 9-person startup; accounting is still being set up and we don't yet issue formal POs. The pilot is expected to be $4–6k USD/mo for the first 2 months.

Can we be onboarded as an "invoice-only" supplier (no-PO) for an initial 60-day pilot? We can provide the following evidence immediately: completed onboarding form, SOC2 summary, ACME bank confirmation letter, and a signed SOW. We understand and accept a spend cap and any additional controls you require.

Attachments: CloudFoundry_onboarding_form.pdf, CFL_SOW_draft.docx, SOC2_summary.pdf

Next steps from our side: let us know the intake checklist and any temporary controls (spend cap, payment terms) you need.

Best,
Anya Patel
CEO, CloudFoundry Labs
procurement@cloudfoundrylabs.com

[Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary supplier onboarding + invoice-only (no PO) for pilot

Folks — forwarding CloudFoundry Labs' request. Short ask: temporary invoice-only onboarding for a startup pilot ($4–6k/mo). They attached the intake form and SOC2 summary.

My read: low-dollar pilot, startup risk but they have a SOC2 summary and bank letter. Proposed mitigations:
- Approve a 60-day invoice-only window with a hard spend cap of $10k.
- Require completed vendor intake + bank confirmation + signed SOW prior to first invoice.
- Finance to issue vendor code and monitor for spend; auto-suspend if cap exceeded.

Action: Rafael — can sales accept the $10k cap and route billing expectations to the customer? Priyom — can procurement/finance run vendor verification and advise whether we need PO-exception approval or if this can be handled as a temporary procurement exception? Laura — FYI for payment/risk.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 13:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary supplier onboarding + invoice-only (no PO) for pilot

Thanks for the ping — happy to move forward under the proposed controls. A few specifics from GTM/ops side:

- Sales OK with a capped, invoice-only pilot. We'll set expectation with the customer: max spend $10,000 for the 60-day trial window; early stop if exceeded.
- Payment terms: Net 30 preferred, but we can accept Net 45 for this startup if finance approves.
- Required artifacts before first invoice: completed intake form, copy of bank confirmation, signed SOW (I confirm they've attached those).
- I'll update the HubSpot opportunity and add a note: CF Labs — trial program, no-PO temporary route. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.redwood/company/CF-LABS-9823

Suggested operational step: Procurement issues a temporary "Exception to PO" that expires in 60 days; finance issues vendor code with two approvers on invoice release. DocuSign link for SOW: https://app.docusign.com/documents/placeholder-id

Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 11:03 AM olga_petrov@redwood.com wrote:
> Folks — forwarding CloudFoundry Labs' request...

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary supplier onboarding + invoice-only (no PO) for pilot

Team — procurement & finance review completed. Summary and decision: APPROVE TEMPORARY EXCEPTION (60 DAYS) WITH CONDITIONS.

Required conditions (all must be completed before first invoice):
1) Vendor intake fully completed and signed (we have the form).
2) Bank confirmation or official payment account statement (they provided bank letter; procurement to validate).
3) SOC2 summary accepted (we have summary; formal report not required for pilot but flag if gaps).
4) SOW signed via DocuSign and countersigned by Redwood legal (Rafael to coordinate).
5) Spend cap = $10,000 for the 60-day window, with automatic suspension if threshold exceeded.
6) Finance to assign vendor code and set payment approval workflow: two approvers required (PM + Finance lead).

Procurement notes: Vendor risk score: LOW-MED (startup; SOC2 summary present). We'll issue an "Exception to PO" document that lasts 60 days and is tied to the vendor code. After 60 days, procurement will review for conversion to standard PO flow; if the customer still cannot issue POs, they'll need to be escalated to Contracts for alternative long-term terms.

I've attached the exception template and the intake validation checklist. Please confirm when SOW is countersigned and I'll finalize the exception and vendor code.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
